title: Clicking a category row opens its page with every field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing one new category made for this test, category A, and no other.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products and Services field shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's Pricing Matrix cell.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens as a page, not a dialog.
  • The breadcrumb reads Settings › Categories › and category A's name.
  • The page shows the name as its title, a Pricing Matrix picker reading matrix A, QuickBooks Products and Services, Tax Exempt and New Matrix.
  • Below them, matrix A's tier grid shows read-only, with Edit.
  • No Price Part Simulator shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Delete.
